title: MINOR/ Is yellow triangle useful for G6 transmitter change ?
body:
When we change G6 transmitters, the  minutes at which the BGs arrive change which triggers the yellow triangle... I'm not sure if this alert is useful. If there are more than 1 delay in BGs, the yellow triangle is a normal information. 

In this case, BGs arrive each 5 min except that the new transmitter starts at a different "minute".
